# DualSubs Universal vendored scripts

These release bundles are copied byte-for-byte from DualSubs/Universal v1.7.5
(release commit `331292a`) under the repository's Apache-2.0 license. They are
vendored here so the test module has no runtime JavaScript dependency outside
this repository.

| `Translate.response.bundle.js` | `3289e75916b05b4700a0394b3dd03f458a68e3806adc3ab3526f45d59d85ba4b` |

The copied files are currently unmodified. Record later local modifications in
this file before changing the bundles.
